metadata.name: memory
metadata.justification: Memory retrieval is a fundamental agent capability that will remain relevant regardless of underlying storage technology. The tier model maps to cognitive science concepts (working/semantic/episodic). Extension points allow adding new tiers without restructuring.

context.problem_statement: AI agents lose context between sessions, repeat past mistakes, and cannot leverage institutional knowledge. They need unified access to past facts, session history, and learned patterns without understanding storage details.
context.who: AI agents working in the ai-agents project ecosystem
context.why: Enable memory-first decision making (ADR-007) by providing simple interface to the tiered memory architecture. Reduce cognitive load on agents.
context.existing_landscape: - curating-memories: Maintenance only - exploring-knowledge-graph: Exploration only - serena-code-architecture: Code analysis, not memory DISTINCTIVENESS: This skill unifies ALL tiers with automation scripts

implicit.requirement: Graceful degradation when a memory store is unreadable
Follow the Python-first constraint (ADR-042, which superseded ADR-005)

discovered.requirement: Clear decision tree for tier selection
Error recovery paths for each operation

pattern.name: Multi-Phase with Decision Tree
pattern.rationale: Complex skill with multiple independent operations. Agent needs decision guidance BEFORE taking action, then clear execution paths.

phase.name: Tier Selection
phase.description: Agent determines which tier(s) to query based on need
phase.decision_tree: need_current_facts → Tier 1 (search_memory.py) need_session_history → Tier 2 (reflexion_memory.get_episode) need_to_store_knowledge → Tier 2 (Extract)

phase.name: Execution
phase.description: Run appropriate script with correct parameters
phase.verification: Script completes without error, output captured

phase.name: Integration
phase.verification: Agent explicitly references memory results in response

decision.question: What kind of knowledge is needed?
decision.default: Start with Tier 1, escalate if insufficient

scripts.decision_summary: needs_scripts: true rationale: Existing Python scripts provide automation. Need validation script.

script_inventory.script: Unified search across Serena and the episode store

agentic_capabilities.autonomous: All scripts can run without human intervention
agentic_capabilities.self_verify: Search returns count, extraction returns JSON, graph returns stats
agentic_capabilities.recovery: Empty result list when a store is unreadable; never an error

evolution_analysis.rationale: Memory retrieval is fundamental to intelligent agents. The tier model (working/semantic/episodic) maps to cognitive science. Storage backends may change but the abstraction remains stable.

extension_points.extension: Custom episode parsers for different log formats
Additional episode consumers with a named reader (see ADR-089)

obsolescence_triggers.trigger: Claude gains native persistent memory (reduces need)

pattern.name: Skipping Memory Search
pattern.why_bad: Ignores institutional knowledge, repeats past mistakes
pattern.alternative: Always search memory before multi-step reasoning

pattern.name: Tier Confusion
pattern.description: Using wrong tier for the task

pattern.name: Assuming a Second Backend
pattern.description: Writing code or prose that expects a semantic memory store beside Serena
pattern.why_bad: The second backend was decommissioned in issue #5574; nothing replaced it
pattern.alternative: Serena is the whole of Tier 1; there is no backend to select or fall back from

pattern.name: Derived Layer Without a Reader
pattern.description: Building an aggregation over episodes that nothing consumes
pattern.why_bad: Cost accrues (size, merge conflicts, maintenance) with no offsetting use; ADR-089 removed one such layer
pattern.alternative: Name the non-memory consumer before building the derived layer

pattern.name: Silent Search Failures
pattern.description: Not checking if search returned useful results
pattern.why_bad: Agent proceeds as if no memory exists
pattern.alternative: Check result count, log "No relevant memories found"

pattern.name: Incomplete Episode Extraction
pattern.why_bad: Writes an incomplete episode that downstream consumers read as fact
pattern.alternative: Only extract from completed sessions with outcomes

criterion.measure: Agent can search memory and integrate results
criterion.verification: Search returns results, agent references them in response

criterion.measure: Agent can extract episode from session
Skill returns results from a readable Serena store
criterion.verification: search_memory returns Serena results; an unreadable store yields an empty list, not an error
scripts/test_memory_health.py returns status for all tiers
